page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v-8x.48xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 192 dedicated physical cores using Intel Xeon 8469C processors operating at a base frequency of 2.6 GHz. The CPU configuration allocates exactly one thread per core, ensuring dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading overhead.

This instance is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 5.33 GB of RAM per core. Acceleration is delivered via eight integrated GPUs with a combined total of 768 GB of VRAM. The instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage.

Networking capabilities include a baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. The lack of local storage represents a key architectural tradeoff, requiring reliance on external storage solutions which may introduce latency compared to local NVMe drives. The high density of dedicated CPU cores and GPU accelerators positions this hardware class for compute-heavy workloads.

Appropriate workloads for this configuration include large-scale deep learning training, complex parallel simulations, high-performance computing tasks, and distributed machine learning inference where massive GPU memory and dedicated CPU cores are required.
